notes: Characteristics, weapon profiles, points and keywords are extracted as facts. Ability, rule, enhancement and stratagem entries carry names and hand-written gists only; the official app is the arbiter for the full text.
Points by size come from the catalogue's cost modifiers; sizes not priced by a modifier are not listed.

army_rules.name: The Shadow of Chaos
army_rules.gist: Your deployment zone is always in shadow; No Man's Land joins it in any phase where you hold at least half of its objectives, and the enemy zone joins when you hold half of theirs. Daemonic Manifestation: a daemon unit in shadow adds 1 to its Battle-shock roll and, on a pass, heals D3 or, if Battleline, returns up to D3 destroyed non-Character models. Daemonic Terror: an enemy unit in shadow, or within 6" of a Greater Daemon, tests Battle-shock at -1 and takes D3 mortal wounds when it fails.

army_rules.name: Warp Rifts
army_rules.gist: A daemon deep-striking wholly inside the shadow, or wholly within 6" of a friendly Greater Daemon of its own god, can be set up more than 6" from the enemy instead of 9".

army_rules.name: Dark Pacts
army_rules.gist: When a unit with it shoots or fights it may take a Leadership test: fail and it suffers D3 mortal wounds, and either way its weapons gain Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1 for the phase. Here Be'lakor and every Heretic Astartes unit have it; Be'lakor passes automatically.

army_rules.name: Harbingers of Dread
army_rules.gist: The Chaos Knights army rule: Dread auras that worsen enemy Leadership near the Knight, growing through the battle. It keys off a Chaos Knights army faction, so as Dreadblades in this army treat it as off unless the app says otherwise.

detachment.name: Shadow Legion

rules.name: First Prince of Chaos
rules.gist: Every unit carries its god's boon as a datasheet ability. Khorne, Murderer's Cowl: Advance and still shoot and charge. Tzeentch, Penumbral Puppetry: Stealth and -1 to be hit in melee. Nurgle, Gloam Rot: -1 to wound when the attack's Strength beats Toughness. Slaanesh, as recorded in July: cannot be Overwatched. Undivided, Disciples of Be'lakor: Dark Pacts, and Deep Strike for Heretic Astartes. Be'lakor must be the Warlord; no Daemon Princes, no vehicles, no Epic Heroes but him; up to half the army from the Thralls of the First Prince allowlist.

enhancements.name: Leaping Shadows
enhancements.gist: The bearer's unit gains Scouts 9": a pre-game move before turn one.

enhancements.name: Mantle of Gloom (Aura)
enhancements.gist: Enemy models in engagement range of the bearer's unit have -1 Objective Control.

enhancements.name: Fade to Darkness
enhancements.gist: At the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer's unit destroyed a unit and is out of engagement range, lift it into Strategic Reserves. The yo-yo.

enhancements.name: Malice Made Manifest
enhancements.gist: At the start of the Fight phase, an enemy unit in engagement range of the bearer's unit takes D3 mortal wounds on a 2 to 5, or 3 on a 6.

stratagems.name: Warp Surge
stratagems.gist: A daemon unit inside the shadow can charge after Advancing. Recorded by the July research; not in BattleScribe data; verify.

stratagems.name: Denizens of the Warp
stratagems.gist: A deep-striking unit arrives more than 3" from the enemy instead of 9". Recorded by the July research; verify.

stratagems.name: Binding Shadow
stratagems.gist: Pull an endangered unit off the board into reserves; the rescue half of the yo-yo. Recorded by the July research with no cost captured; verify.

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress (core)
stratagems.gist: The core stratagem that brings a Faded unit back in the opponent's turn. A Chaos Lord's Lord of Chaos makes it free for his own squad once per round.

detachment.stratagems_note: BattleScribe data carries no stratagems. These are the ones this repo's research recorded; names, costs and timing must be read from the app.

ranged.name: Betraying Shades - focused witchfire
ranged.Keywords: Devastating Wounds, Hazardous, Ignores Cover, Psychic

abilities.name: The Dark Master (Aura)
abilities.gist: Everything within 6" of him counts as inside your Shadow of Chaos.

abilities.name: Shadow Form
abilities.gist: At the start of each battle round choose one of the three auras below; he has it for the round.

abilities.name: Wreathed in Shadows (Aura, Psychic)
abilities.gist: Friendly daemon and Shadow Legion units within 6" can only be shot from within 18".

abilities.name: Pall of Despair (Aura, Psychic)
abilities.gist: In the enemy Command phase, enemy units below starting strength within 9" must take a Battle-shock test; he heals D3 for each failure.

abilities.name: Shadow Lord (Aura, Psychic)
abilities.gist: Friendly daemon and Shadow Legion units within 6" re-roll hit rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-6 wounds remaining
abilities.gist: At 6 wounds or fewer it hits at -1.

abilities.name: Disciples of Be'lakor
abilities.gist: The Undivided boon: Dark Pacts (Be'lakor passes the Leadership test automatically), and Deep Strike for Heretic Astartes models.

strategy.role: Warlord, umbrella and shadow engine
strategy.play: Round one, Wreathed in Shadows: nothing within 6" of him can be shot from beyond 18", so castle the Horrors, Flamers and Legionaries under his wings and make the enemy walk into the shadow to shoot. Once the fighting starts, Shadow Lord for re-roll 1s across the castle or the strike wave. The round after you have damaged units sitting near objectives, Pall of Despair: forced tests at -1 inside the shadow, D3 mortal wounds per failure, and he heals D3 per failure. He is a fighter second. The strike profile (7 attacks, S14, AP-4, D6+1, Devastating Wounds) kills a Character or a light tank; the sweep (14 attacks, S8, AP-3, Sustained Hits 1) clears infantry. Keep him at 7 or more wounds where you can; at 6 he hits at -1.
strategy.pairs_with: Legionaries and Possessed, which deep-strike beside him and Dark Pact inside his re-roll aura; the Horrors, whose Manifestation only works inside a shadow; a second monster on the other flank so two bubbles cover the midfield.
strategy.beware: Anti-monster shooting inside 18": a 4+ invulnerable and a 3+ save do not survive massed AP-2. Chaff that ties him up away from objectives. He is an Epic Hero, so no enhancement.

abilities.name: Daemon Lord of Tzeentch (Aura)
abilities.gist: Friendly Tzeentch daemons within 6", himself included, add 1 to the Strength of ranged attacks.

abilities.name: Master of Magicks (Psychic)
abilities.gist: Each of your Shooting phases, Bolt of Change gains Ignores Cover, Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits D3.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-7 wounds remaining
abilities.gist: At 7 wounds or fewer it hits at -1.

abilities.name: Greater Daemon of Tzeentch (Aura)
abilities.gist: Friendly Tzeentch daemons within 6" count as inside the shadow.

abilities.name: Penumbral Puppetry
abilities.gist: The Tzeentch boon: Stealth, and melee attacks against this unit hit at -1.

strategy.role: The army's only real gun and its second shadow bubble
strategy.play: Stand him 6" behind the Horrors and Flamers so their flames gain a point of Strength and his bubble covers them, then shoot: Bolt of Change (9 shots, S9 or S10 under his own aura, AP-1) with Lethal Hits into vehicles or Sustained Hits D3 into infantry; the focused profile (AP-2, D3, Hazardous) only when the target is worth a mortal wound to himself; the Rod adds six S8 D2 shots. He flies 12" and deep-strikes, so he can also be the second arrival with Be'lakor. Stealth and the 4+ invulnerable keep him alive, not the 6+ armour.
strategy.pairs_with: Pink Horrors, Flamers, the Exalted Flamer and the Fateskimmer (all +1 Strength shooting within 6"); Be'lakor for double bubbles.
strategy.beware: A 6+ save: volume of fire wounds him on saves alone. Keep him out of melee against anything that hits back; the staff is adequate, not good.

abilities.name: Daemon Lord of Khorne (Aura)
abilities.gist: Friendly Khorne daemons within 6", himself included, add 1 to melee hit rolls.

abilities.name: Relentless Carnage
abilities.gist: At the end of the Fight phase, pick an enemy unit in engagement range and roll eight dice: each 4+ is a mortal wound.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-6 wounds remaining
abilities.gist: At 6 wounds or fewer it hits at -1.

abilities.name: Greater Daemon of Khorne (Aura)
abilities.gist: Friendly Khorne daemons within 6" count as inside the shadow.

abilities.name: Murderer's Cowl
abilities.gist: The Khorne boon: this unit can Advance and still shoot and charge in the same turn.

strategy.role: The Fade loop and the army's anti-tank
strategy.play: Great axe strike: 7 attacks on 2+, S16, AP-4, D6+2 damage. That is a tank or a Knight-class model in one activation, then Relentless Carnage rolls eight dice for mortal wounds on whatever is still standing. With Fade to Darkness: arrive, kill, and if nothing else is in engagement range vanish into Strategic Reserves at the end of the phase; Rapid Ingress him back in the opponent's turn for 1 CP. Under the Khorne boon he Advances and still charges, so his threat range is 12" plus D6 plus 2D6. Hellfire breath (D6 Torrent shots) is a footnote; never shoot when you could charge.
strategy.pairs_with: Bloodletters and Bloodcrushers, which get +1 to hit in melee within 6" and can deep-strike 6" from the enemy beside him under Warp Rifts; a Bloodmaster's brick as the follow-up wave.
strategy.beware: Fade needs him clear of engagement range: kill the whole unit or finish it with Relentless Carnage. Anti-tank guns within 18" will pick him first. Build the Games Workshop kit to the great axe; the resin copy is casual-only.

abilities.name: Daemon Lord of Nurgle (Aura)
abilities.gist: Friendly Nurgle daemons within 6" get +1 Toughness.

abilities.name: Nurgle’s Rot (Psychic)
abilities.gist: At the end of your Movement phase, one enemy unit within 12" loses 1 Toughness until your next Movement phase.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-7 wounds remaining
abilities.gist: At 7 wounds or fewer it hits at -1.

abilities.name: Greater Daemon of Nurgle (Aura)
abilities.gist: Friendly Nurgle daemons within 6" count as inside the shadow.

abilities.name: Gloam Rot
abilities.gist: The Nurgle boon: an attack whose Strength beats this unit's Toughness wounds at -1.

abilities.name: Reverberating Summons
abilities.gist: Doomsday bell only: each model it kills returns a destroyed Plaguebearer to a nearby Plaguebearers unit. Irrelevant without Plaguebearers.

strategy.role: Centre anchor, once the crate is opened
strategy.play: Park him on the middle objective and let the game come to him: T12, 20 wounds, a 4+ invulnerable, OC5, and every nearby Nurgle daemon at +1 Toughness. Nurgle's Rot drops one enemy unit's Toughness for a turn, which helps the whole army wound it. In melee the bilesword strike (6 attacks, S10, AP-2, D6+1, Lethal Hits) and the bileblade do the work; Putrid vomit is D6+3 Torrent shots at AP-2 for anything that comes close. With Mantle of Gloom he strips a point of Objective Control from every enemy in engagement range, which is how he steals a marker he is only sharing.
strategy.pairs_with: Nurglings (T3 to T4 under him, and his shadow bubble reaches the midfield if they infiltrate near it); Beasts and Drones if the list goes Nurgle; Mantle of Gloom.
strategy.beware: 7" move: he arrives where he was deployed. Gloam Rot only matters against Strength 13 and up on him. Do not put him in any list until the crate is counted and the model confirmed genuine.

abilities.name: Fateskimmer
abilities.gist: While leading, the unit's melee weapons gain Lethal Hits.

abilities.name: Rider of the Immaterial Winds
abilities.gist: Once per battle, at the end of the enemy turn, if the unit is not in engagement range, lift it into Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Penumbral Puppetry
abilities.gist: The Tzeentch boon: Stealth, and melee attacks against this unit hit at -1.

strategy.role: Fast harassment and the Screamers' Lethal Hits
strategy.play: Lead the Screamers. 14" of flight, Slashing Dive mortal wounds on the way over, Lethal Hits on the bites when they land, and once per battle the whole unit lifts into reserves at the end of the enemy turn to come back where it is wanted. Leaping Shadows on him puts the unit 9" up before turn one. Arcane Fireball is three real shots for 95 points; the focused profile is Hazardous, so save it for a wounded Character.
strategy.pairs_with: Screamers; the Lord of Change's aura for +1 Strength on the fireball and the bites.
strategy.beware: T7 with a 6+ save lives on its 4+ invulnerable. Do not end the enemy turn in engagement range if you want the reserves trick; use Rider of the Immaterial Winds to leave before the counter-charge.

abilities.name: Blazing Warpfire (Psychic)
abilities.gist: While leading, the unit's ranged weapons gain Assault.

abilities.name: Flames of Change (Psychic)
abilities.gist: After shooting, one non-Monster, non-Vehicle unit it hit is set aflame on a 4+: -2" Move and -2 to Advance and Charge rolls until the end of the enemy's next turn.

abilities.name: Manifestation of Destruction
abilities.gist: Cannot be your Warlord and cannot take an enhancement.

abilities.name: Penumbral Puppetry
abilities.gist: The Tzeentch boon: Stealth, and melee attacks against this unit hit at -1.

strategy.role: The Flamers' officer: Assault and a slow
strategy.play: Attach to the Flamers so the unit Advances and still shoots, then pick the enemy unit that most wants to charge you and set it aflame: -2" Move and -2 to its Charge roll turns a 9" charge into a 7" one that usually fails. Blue fire is three S9 AP-3 D3 shots for a vehicle or a monster; pink fire is 2D6 Torrent shots for infantry.
strategy.pairs_with: Flamers; the Lord of Change for +1 Strength on everything.
strategy.beware: Six wounds on T4 with no armour: exposed, it is the first thing a bolter squad kills. Cannot carry an enhancement and cannot be the Warlord.

abilities.name: Bloodmaster
abilities.gist: While leading, the unit's attacks add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: A Gory Path
abilities.gist: The unit consolidates up to 6" instead of 3".

abilities.name: Murderer's Cowl
abilities.gist: The Khorne boon: this unit can Advance and still shoot and charge in the same turn.

strategy.role: The brick's +1 to wound and its extra reach
strategy.play: Ten Bloodletters wounding at +1 is the whole point: hellblades wound marines on 3+ instead of 4+ and Toughness 5 on 4+ instead of 5+. The 6" consolidate rolls the brick into the next unit or onto the objective after a kill. Leaping Shadows on him scouts the brick 9" forward; with the Khorne boon it Advances and charges on turn one.
strategy.pairs_with: Bloodletters; a Bloodthirster within 6" for +1 to hit; Be'lakor's Shadow Lord for re-roll 1s.
strategy.beware: Four wounds: keep him in the middle of the unit, and never accept a challenge from a Character with Precision.

abilities.name: Skullmaster’s Fury
abilities.gist: While leading, after the unit ends a charge its Juggernaut horns gain Devastating Wounds for the turn.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.gist: After his unit ends a charge, every enemy unit in engagement range takes a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Murderer's Cowl
abilities.gist: The Khorne boon: this unit can Advance and still shoot and charge in the same turn.

strategy.role: Turns six Bloodcrushers into a mortal-wound freight train
strategy.play: Brass Stampede's mortal wounds on impact, then every Juggernaut horn with Devastating Wounds, then a Battle-shock test at -1 inside the shadow for every unit the charge touched, with D3 more mortal wounds per failure. Leaping Shadows on him is the tournament build: scout 9", Advance, charge on turn one under the Khorne boon.
strategy.pairs_with: Bloodcrushers; the Rendmaster's Blood Throne target; a Bloodthirster's +1 to hit.
strategy.beware: Not owned. Once bought, he is the unit's anchor: T7, six wounds, 3+ save; keep him out of the front rank against power fists.

abilities.name: Blood Throne
abilities.gist: At the start of the Fight phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 18": every friendly Khorne daemon's attacks against it get +1 Strength, +1 AP and +1 Damage.

abilities.name: Champion Slayer
abilities.gist: Re-roll wound rolls in melee against Characters and Monsters; kill one and he heals D6.

abilities.name: Murderer's Cowl
abilities.gist: The Khorne boon: this unit can Advance and still shoot and charge in the same turn.

strategy.role: Support artillery for the melee: +1 Strength, AP and Damage into one target
strategy.play: Solo. Stay 18" behind the cavalry and the letters with line of sight to their target and name it each Fight phase: hellblades become S6 AP-3 D3, the great axe becomes S17 AP-5 D6+3. He is not a leader; he is a buff that rides. Characters and Monsters that come to him meet re-rolled wounds and heal him D6 when they die.
strategy.pairs_with: Everything Khorne, the Bloodthirster most of all.
strategy.beware: Not owned, and 160 points of support that does nothing alone. Blood Throne needs the target visible.

abilities.name: Chance for Glory
abilities.gist: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, his melee weapons get +1 Strength, Attacks, AP and Damage for the phase.

abilities.name: Lord of Chaos
abilities.gist: Once per battle round, a stratagem used on his unit costs 1 CP less. Rapid Ingress for his squad becomes free.

strategy.role: The Fade carrier and the stratagem discount
strategy.play: Lead five Legionaries with Fade to Darkness. Deep-strike them, Dark Pact for Lethal Hits, charge the unit babysitting an objective, kill it, and if nothing else is in engagement range Fade into reserves at the end of the phase. In the opponent's turn, Rapid Ingress the squad back for 0 CP through Lord of Chaos, 9" from the enemy (Warp Rifts is for daemons, not marines). Save Chance for Glory for a Character: a daemon hammer at 6 attacks, S9, AP-3, D3 with Devastating Wounds ends one.
strategy.pairs_with: Legionaries (owned) or Chosen (not); Be'lakor's aura when the squad lands beside him.
strategy.beware: Five wounds. The yo-yo only works if the squad kills something every time: pick soft targets, not the enemy's hammer. A failed Dark Pact test costs D3 mortal wounds; a chaos icon in the squad re-rolls it.

abilities.name: Daemonkin (Psychic)
abilities.gist: While leading, +1 to the unit's Advance and Charge rolls.

abilities.name: Sacrificial Dagger
abilities.gist: Once per phase when he shoots or fights, his unit takes a mortal wound and his psychic attacks get +1 to hit and +1 to wound.

strategy.role: The Possessed bomb's charge insurance
strategy.play: Attach to the Possessed: +1 to Advance and Charge makes a 9" deep-strike charge an 8" one, and Denizens of the Warp (as recorded) makes it a 3" one. Shoot the Rite of Possession first (Precision, Anti-Psyker 2+, AP-3); pay the Sacrificial Dagger's mortal wound only when a Character is the target. In this detachment he can also lead Legionaries or Chosen as a second Dark Pacts unit.
strategy.pairs_with: Possessed; Legionaries or Chosen.
strategy.beware: Four wounds, 5+ invulnerable: the softest character in the army. Never the first model into a fight.

abilities.name: Split
abilities.gist: When a Pink Horror dies, on a 4+ two Blue Horrors replace it; when a Blue dies, on a 4+ a Brimstone does, provided the unit survived the attack.

abilities.name: Horrors are Pink. Horrors are Blue. Where once there was one, now there are two.
abilities.gist: Once the last Pink is gone, the unit uses the Blue Horrors datasheet.

abilities.name: Penumbral Puppetry
abilities.gist: The Tzeentch boon: Stealth, and melee attacks against this unit hit at -1.

abilities.name: Daemonic Icon
abilities.gist: Wargear: the unit's Leadership becomes 6+, so Battle-shock and Manifestation tests pass more often.

abilities.name: Instrument of Chaos
abilities.gist: Wargear: +1 to the unit's Charge rolls.

strategy.role: The objective that will not die
strategy.play: Ten Battleline bodies at OC2 each with a 4+ invulnerable, Stealth and -1 to be hit in melee, that split into Blues on a 4+ and get up to D3 models back each time they pass a Battle-shock test inside the shadow. Stand them on the objective you intend to keep, under a monster's bubble, and shoot the flames at whatever closes (S5 under the Lord of Change). Take the icon: Leadership 6+ passes the Manifestation test more often, which is the whole engine.
strategy.pairs_with: Lord of Change, Be'lakor, Flamers screening in front.
strategy.beware: Toughness 3 with no armour: flamers and Blast chew them, and the split only triggers if the unit survives the attack. They hold; they do not fight.

abilities.name: Bane of Cowards
abilities.gist: Enemy infantry falling back from them take Desperate Escape tests, at -1 if Battle-shocked.

abilities.name: Murderer's Cowl
abilities.gist: The Khorne boon: this unit can Advance and still shoot and charge in the same turn.

abilities.name: Instrument of Chaos
abilities.gist: Wargear: +1 to the unit's Charge rolls.

abilities.name: Daemonic Icon
abilities.gist: Wargear: the unit's Leadership becomes 6+, so Battle-shock and Manifestation tests pass more often.

strategy.role: The mid-board hammer
strategy.play: Twenty hellblade attacks at S5, AP-2, D2, +1 to wound with a Bloodmaster, +1 to hit near a Bloodthirster. Advance and charge under the Khorne boon: 8" plus D6 plus 2D6, plus 1 with the instrument. Point them at objective holders: a dead unit scores nothing, and a unit that runs from them takes Desperate Escape tests. Inside the shadow the brick regrows D3 models per passed Battle-shock test, so a mauled brick on an objective is still a problem.
strategy.pairs_with: Bloodmaster, Bloodthirster, Rendmaster.
strategy.beware: 5+ invulnerable and no armour: Overwatch and screens cost models before the charge lands. Two full bricks need twenty models; confirm the count.

abilities.name: Veterans of the Long War
abilities.gist: In melee, re-roll wound rolls of 1; against a unit on an objective, re-roll any wound roll.

abilities.name: Chaos icon
abilities.gist: Wargear: re-roll the Leadership test for a Dark Pact.

strategy.role: The mortal half: objectives, actions, and the yo-yo's body
strategy.play: Two fives. One carries Mallex and Fade and does the yo-yo; the other holds the home objective and does actions. In melee against a unit on an objective they re-roll every wound roll, and a Dark Pact adds Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1: that is a real fight for 90 points. The detachment gives them Deep Strike, so either five can start in reserve. Build each five with a heavy weapon and a special (lascannon or heavy bolter, plasma gun), a chainsword or two, and a chaos icon on the squad that makes pacts.
strategy.pairs_with: Chaos Lord, Master of Possession, Be'lakor's Shadow Lord (Shadow Legion units re-roll 1s under him).
strategy.beware: OC2 marines are the best objective holders per point in the army, and T4 W2 dies to everything. The yo-yo squad must never be left in the open after a failed charge. Log the painted loadouts: WYSIWYG.

abilities.name: For the Dark Gods
abilities.gist: At the end of your Command phase, an objective they stand on and you control stays yours after they leave, until the enemy takes it.

strategy.role: Sticky home objective and a screen
strategy.play: Stand on the home objective at the end of the Command phase and it stays yours after they walk away: that frees them to screen the deep-strike lanes in front of the Havocs, or to block a charge into the Horrors. Ten OC1 bodies for 50 points is the cheapest control you can buy. They deep-strike too, which is occasionally right for a late objective grab.
strategy.pairs_with: Havocs; Nurglings (the two screens).
strategy.beware: They die to a stiff breeze and hand over Purge the Foe points. Never trade them for nothing.

abilities.name: Split
abilities.gist: When a Pink Horror dies, on a 4+ two Blue Horrors replace it; when a Blue dies, on a 4+ a Brimstone does, provided the unit survived the attack.

abilities.name: Sullen Malevolence (Aura)
abilities.gist: While a Blue remains, enemy units within 6" have -1 Leadership.

abilities.name: Exploding Horrors
abilities.gist: When the unit fights, Brimstones in it can explode: each is destroyed on a 4+ and deals a mortal wound.

abilities.name: Penumbral Puppetry
abilities.gist: The Tzeentch boon: Stealth, and melee attacks against this unit hit at -1.

strategy.role: A second Battleline holder that leaks Leadership
strategy.play: As their own unit they are ten Battleline bodies with a -1 Leadership aura: beside Be'lakor and Pall of Despair, enemy Battle-shock tests near the objective start failing, which is mortal wounds and OC 0. Brimstones they split into explode for mortal wounds in melee.
strategy.pairs_with: Be'lakor; the Pinks' bubble.
strategy.beware: Weaker than Pinks in every stat and OC1. Fielding them separately leaves the Pinks nothing to split into; use the nine Brimstones as stand-ins.

abilities.name: Bounding Leaps
abilities.gist: Can shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

abilities.name: Penumbral Puppetry
abilities.gist: The Tzeentch boon: Stealth, and melee attacks against this unit hit at -1.

strategy.role: Overwatch and objective clearance
strategy.play: D6 Torrent shots each that auto-hit, so Fire Overwatch actually hits, and they can shoot after Falling Back: fall back out of a charge and flame the chargers, or Overwatch the unit that comes for the Horrors. Led by the Exalted Flamer they Advance and shoot, and under the Lord of Change the flames are S5.
strategy.pairs_with: Exalted Flamer, Lord of Change, Pink Horrors.
strategy.beware: Three wounds each and no armour: a screen with a flamethrower, not a firebase.

abilities.name: Slashing Dive
abilities.gist: After a Normal move, one enemy unit it flew over takes a mortal wound per Screamer on a 4+.

abilities.name: Penumbral Puppetry
abilities.gist: The Tzeentch boon: Stealth, and melee attacks against this unit hit at -1.

strategy.role: Mortal wounds on the move, and secondaries
strategy.play: Fly 14" over a screen, roll for mortal wounds, land on the far objective or the secondary marker. The bites are Anti-Monster and Anti-Vehicle 4+, so with the Fateskimmer's Lethal Hits they can bite a tank. Never charge something that fights back unless the Fateskimmer is with them.
strategy.pairs_with: Fateskimmer.
strategy.beware: Three T4 wounds each with a 6+ save: they die when targeted, so end every move out of sight.

abilities.name: Mischief Makers (Aura)
abilities.gist: Enemy units in engagement range of them hit at -1 in melee.

abilities.name: Gloam Rot
abilities.gist: The Nurgle boon: an attack whose Strength beats this unit's Toughness wounds at -1.

strategy.role: The screen that starts in the middle
strategy.play: Infiltrate onto a midfield objective or into the lane the enemy wants to charge through. OC0 means they never hold, but they deny: a unit that charges them fights at -1 to hit, wounds them at -1 if it is strong, and spends a turn. They are Battleline, so inside the shadow they get bases back on a passed Battle-shock test.
strategy.pairs_with: Be'lakor, whose bubble reaches the midfield if he follows; the Great Unclean One for +1 Toughness.
strategy.beware: OC0: they will not score. Do not stand them where a Blast weapon gets a free kill on a four-wound base.

abilities.name: Hunters from the Warp
abilities.gist: At the end of the enemy turn, if not in engagement range, lift them into Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Murderer's Cowl
abilities.gist: The Khorne boon: this unit can Advance and still shoot and charge in the same turn.

abilities.name: Collar of Khorne
abilities.gist: Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks.

strategy.role: Objective raider and reserve-hopper
strategy.play: 12" move, Advance and charge, then at the end of the enemy turn lift into reserves and come back where the game needs them. Far objective on turn one, backfield Character on turn three. Burning roar is D6 Torrent shots; use it before charging.
strategy.pairs_with: Bloodthirster for +1 to hit; Be'lakor.
strategy.beware: Two wounds, no armour, 5+ invulnerable: not a brick. Keep the Gore Hound in the middle.

abilities.name: Brass Stampede
abilities.gist: After ending a charge, pick an enemy unit in engagement range and roll a die per model: each 4+ is D3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Murderer's Cowl
abilities.gist: The Khorne boon: this unit can Advance and still shoot and charge in the same turn.

abilities.name: Instrument of Chaos
abilities.gist: Wargear: +1 to the unit's Charge rolls.

abilities.name: Daemonic Icon
abilities.gist: Wargear: the unit's Leadership becomes 6+, so Battle-shock and Manifestation tests pass more often.

strategy.role: The armoured fist
strategy.play: T7, four wounds, 3+ save cavalry that Advances and charges with mortal wounds on impact: six of them average three 4+ rolls for 3D3 mortal wounds before a blade swings, then twelve hellblade attacks and the Lance horns. With a Skullmaster the horns get Devastating Wounds and the charge forces Battle-shock tests. Take the instrument.
strategy.pairs_with: Skullmaster, Rendmaster, Bloodthirster.
strategy.beware: Uncatalogued: count and repair them first. 10" move, no Fly, so terrain matters. Six of them at 200 points is one big anti-tank target.

abilities.name: Grotesque Regeneration
abilities.gist: At the end of every phase, a damaged Beast that is still alive heals to full.

abilities.name: Gloam Rot
abilities.gist: The Nurgle boon: an attack whose Strength beats this unit's Toughness wounds at -1.

strategy.role: The objective that heals to full
strategy.play: Sit one on a flank objective: T9, seven wounds, -1 to be wounded by anything stronger than T9, and every wound heals at the end of the phase unless the unit dies in one go. The opponent must kill it in one phase or not at all. OC3 for 80 points.
strategy.pairs_with: Great Unclean One (T10 under his aura); Nurglings.
strategy.beware: Not owned; 6" move is the price.

abilities.name: Death’s Heads
abilities.gist: After shooting, pick a unit they hit: friendly Nurgle daemons re-roll wound rolls against it this turn.

abilities.name: Gloam Rot
abilities.gist: The Nurgle boon: an attack whose Strength beats this unit's Toughness wounds at -1.

abilities.name: Daemonic Icon
abilities.gist: Wargear: the unit's Leadership becomes 6+, so Battle-shock and Manifestation tests pass more often.

abilities.name: Instrument of Chaos
abilities.gist: Wargear: +1 to the unit's Charge rolls.

strategy.role: Fast, tough errand-runners
strategy.play: 10" fly over screens to secondaries; T8 and five wounds a model is hard to shift for 110. Their re-roll-to-wound mark matters only when other Nurgle daemons fight the same target.
strategy.pairs_with: Great Unclean One.
strategy.beware: Not owned.

abilities.name: Unholy Bloodshed
abilities.gist: Once per battle, when they make a Dark Pact their weapons also gain Devastating Wounds for the phase.

abilities.name: Chaos icon
abilities.gist: Wargear: re-roll the Leadership test for a Dark Pact.

strategy.role: The deep-striking bomb
strategy.play: Five T6, three-wound, 3+ save bodies moving 9" that deep-strike from the detachment and land with the monsters. Dark Pact for Sustained Hits 1, and once per battle Unholy Bloodshed adds Devastating Wounds: that is the phase you hit a Character or a Monster. The Master of Possession's +1 to charge and Denizens of the Warp make the charge land.
strategy.pairs_with: Master of Possession; the Chaos Lord's Legionaries as a second wave.
strategy.beware: OC1 each: they do not hold objectives. A failed 9" charge leaves them standing in the open.

abilities.name: Stabilisation Talons
abilities.gist: Their shooting ignores every modifier to the hit roll and to Ballistic Skill.

strategy.role: The home firebase
strategy.play: Two lascannons and two autocannons on the home objective with sightlines, Dark Pact for Lethal Hits every turn there is a target worth D3 mortal wounds of risk. Their hit rolls ignore modifiers, so Stealth targets and their own movement do not matter.
strategy.pairs_with: Cultists in front; Legionaries B on the same objective.
strategy.beware: T5 but 5" move: they never relocate. Deep-striking them is legal and almost never right.

abilities.name: Chosen Marauders
abilities.gist: Can shoot and charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

abilities.name: Chaos icon
abilities.gist: Wargear: re-roll the Leadership test for a Dark Pact.

strategy.role: Durable scoring marines, on the buy list
strategy.play: Three-wound marines that Advance or Fall Back and still shoot and charge, with Dark Pacts. In list C they are the second deep-strike wave.
strategy.pairs_with: Chaos Lord or Master of Possession.
strategy.beware: Not owned; OC1.

abilities.name: Warp Strike
abilities.gist: At the end of the Fight phase, if they destroyed a unit and are out of engagement range, lift them into Strategic Reserves. A built-in Fade.

strategy.role: A second yo-yo without the enhancement
strategy.play: Deep-strike, kill, vanish, return: the same loop as Mallex's squad on 12" jump packs, without spending Fade to Darkness. Rapid Ingress costs the full CP for them.
strategy.pairs_with: The Chaos Lord's squad, alternating turns.
strategy.beware: Not owned.

abilities.name: Karnivore
abilities.gist: Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-5 wounds remaining
abilities.gist: At 5 wounds or fewer it hits at -1 and loses 3 Objective Control.

abilities.name: *Invulnerable Save
abilities.gist: The 5+ invulnerable save applies against ranged attacks only.

strategy.role: Fast anti-tank and OC6 on a far objective, as an ally
strategy.play: 14" move with re-rolled Advances and Charges: they reach the far objective on turn one and hold it at OC6 each. The slaughterclaw (S12, AP-3, D6+2) is the anti-tank the daemons cannot buy; the chaintalon's twelve attacks clear infantry. They sit outside the Shadow Legion's rules: no enhancements, never the Warlord.
strategy.pairs_with: Each other, as two targets; the Havocs' lascannons on the same target.
strategy.beware: The invulnerable save is against shooting only; fists and hammers go through the 3+. At five wounds they lose 3 OC. Verify the Dreadblades allowance before a tournament.

datasheets.name: Daemon Prince of Chaos with wings
keywords: Daemon Prince of Chaos with wings

profiles.name: Daemon Prince of Chaos with wings

abilities.name: Malefic Destruction
abilities.gist: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, +3 Attacks on the hellforged weapons.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Death
abilities.gist: Each time he fights, his hellforged weapons gain Lethal Hits, Precision or Sustained Hits 1.

abilities.name: Seductive Gambit
abilities.gist: After a charge he may give up Fights First to re-roll hits and re-roll wound rolls of 1.

strategy.role: Illegal in the Shadow Legion; a stand-in or another detachment's flanker
strategy.play: Nowhere in this book. In Daemonic Incursion or a mono-god legion he is a 12" flying character-hunter with Precision on demand. Casually he stands in for the Bloodthirster on a 120mm oval until the real one is built.
strategy.pairs_with: Nothing here.
strategy.beware: The detachment bans Daemon Princes outright; the validator refuses him.
